note: Family-run cabin and camping resort on Robinson Creek off Twin Lakes Road, 7 mi from Bridgeport in the Eastern Sierra, about 3 mi below Twin Lakes. Back-in RV sites sit in an open meadow beside the creekside cabins; dry campsites take trailers only in some spots, so call ahead. Showers are coin-operated. --Claude
summary: Hunewill's Doc and Al's (private, Bridgeport): $45 full-hookup 30A RV sites / $35 dry sites (under the $50 gate), 2-night minimum all season, 20 RV + 23 campsites beside 31 rental cabins/trailers, season 04-24..10-31, Google 4.7 (133); keep; WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE creekside -> not waterfront recommended (only the creekside cabins are tagged Waterfront; RV sites in the meadow, the pine belt between them and the creek).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (recommend creekside -> not waterfront; value is --Claude): the operator's engine tags only the 10 Creekside cabins 'Waterfront'; the 20 'Standard RV Site' units and the 23 'Campsite' units carry no water tag. On Esri imagery the RV/trailer sites are an open meadow loop and row around 38.2106-38.2115,-119.3180, east of the continuous pine belt along Robinson Creek that holds the cabins; no RV or dry site can be named at the creek. Re-audit lead if a site map shows dry campsites on the bank.

LONG-STAY / NIGHTLY: 'Contact us for long term stays deals' on the RV rate and returning-guest rebooking at check-out ('All sites that have not been reserved will open up on our online booking engine at a later date'), but RV sites sell by the night online at $45 with a 2-night minimum, and the season is a transient summer one (resort closed Nov-Apr). Google 4.7 from 133 reviews. Not mostly seasonal on this evidence; keep.

CABIN-FIRST check: 17 cabins + 7 rustic cabins + 7 rental trailers vs 20 RV sites + 23 campsites; the home page leads with lodging, but RV sites are a full category. Not a drop on its own; reviewer's call.
MIN STAY: 2 nights the whole season for RV spots and campsites (not 3+). Creekside cabins are week-only Sunday-Sunday in June-August; cabins are not the entry.
PHONE: (760) 932-7051 confirmed; operator also lists 775-495-0772. Website confirmed. Google pin 38.210141,-119.319175 matches the stored pin.
